data.summary_en: AdaRSI: an on-demand recursive self-improvement framework that enhances skills and harness, attributes failures by retrying failed sub-steps, and fine-tunes only still-unreliable sub-steps. Across all 50 RoboCasa365 target tasks, lifting unseen composite success rate from 4.6% to 13.8% at 28% of full sub-step fine-tuning GPU time.
